query: UPDATE block_properties SET value_list = (SELECT json_group_array( CASE WHEN je.value = ?3 THEN ?4 ELSE je.value END ORDER BY je.key) FROM json_each(block_properties.value_list) je) WHERE key = ?2 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(block_properties.value_list) je WHERE je.value = ?3) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM blocks b WHERE b.id = block_properties.block_id AND (b.space_id = ?1 OR b.id = ?1))
